title: Honest Scales

readiness.math: balancing a weight; equal weight (older: big scoops weigh two)
readiness.reading: pre-reader friendly; all text can be read aloud

intro.speaker: tobias
intro.text: Customers buy my flour by weight. This stone weight says how much a bag should be.

intro.speaker: tobias
intro.text: The Bible says God delights in honest scales. So let's be careful: not a scoop too few, and not a scoop too many.

steps.speaker: tobias
steps.prompt: Add scoops of flour to the pan until the beam hangs level.
steps.hint: Is the beam tipping? Then the scoops are lighter or heavier than the weight.

older.hint: Count the dots on the weight, and the dots on the scoops. Can you make them the same?

feedback.heavy: Too much! The flour side is heavier. Take a scoop out.
feedback.all_good: Level! That's an honest bag of flour.

outro.speaker: tobias
outro.text: Now everyone who buys it gets just what they paid for. That's fair.

journal_line: I weighed flour on the honest scales with Mr. Tobias.
unavailable_text: The flour is weighed for today.
